preconditions.description: Number of test cases is between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 10**5 for n in ns)
preconditions.description: Length of each sequence is between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 10**9 for a_i in as_list)
preconditions.description: Each element in the sequence is between 1 and 1,000,000,000.
Total length of all sequences does not exceed 100,000.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines matches the number of test cases.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(line, int) for line in output)
postconditions.description: Each output line is an integer.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= result <= n * (n - 1) // 2 for result, n in zip(output, ns))
postconditions.description: Each result is a non-negative integer not exceeding the maximum possible weight of a sequence of length n.
